The exact [#1793](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/pull/1793) candidate merged at 20:19:27 JST. Actual main `94b35584081a80ab5e302fd9e237a95beb95ba66`, tree `720fe1b1995639628950315d312d8308bbf08219`, ordered parents `048a9d3d5d65f45b11e3983567f9783b19611ff5` and `6b9940bb3685570ea5b39e1d8b810980e7cb94f1`, [CURRENT_SPEC → Draft17.38](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/blob/94b35584081a80ab5e302fd9e237a95beb95ba66/docs/reference/CURRENT_SPEC.md). [Natural main FULL](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/actions/runs/45603371493/attempts/1) and [PARTIAL](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/actions/runs/45603371415/attempts/1) are pending under C audit.

Apply the [recovery note](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/issues/1794#issuecomment-7160819222) in the same existing P task. Once execution returns, verify the actual workspace, worktree and latest adopted pin. Keep the original FIRST's old actual-main and #1793 HEAD as comparison pins, the original forecast and first failure. Run Gate0 with frozen sources and pin each binary. Build any implementation on the new actual main under the existing scope/STOP. P retains implementation and verification discretion. POST and individually GET resumed ACTUAL with actual environment/worktree before measuring. If commands remain unavailable, keep FIRST intact and report the specific recovery dependency.

```text
既存の sole Track P として #1794 の更新指示を個別 GET してください。P の元タスクで実行環境が戻ったら、FIRST と初回の環境エラーを保全し、実 main 94b35584081a80ab5e302fd9e237a95beb95ba66 と作業ツリーを確認して Gate0 を再開してください。FIRST の旧 main／#1793 HEAD は比較用に保全してください。再開 ACTUAL を #1794 に POST／個別 GET。実装と検証は P の裁量です。
```
